carousels.title: AI Vendor Liability
carousels.caption:
Mortgage servicers are still responsible when AI vendors get it wrong. Here's what this means for the industry. With the increasing use of AI in mortgage servicing, the liability for errors remains with the servicers. This has significant implications for the industry and requires careful consideration of AI vendor contracts and controls.

Source : https://tinyurl.com/25sv2vuc
#SafetrustMortgage #MortgageIntelligenceDaily #aimortgage #mortgageservicing #compliance
carousels.what_happened: Mortgage servicers remain responsible for account decisions influenced by vendor AI. The OCC model risk guidance, GSE requirements, and Treasury AI controls all point to servicer liability. This means that servicers need to carefully manage their AI vendors and ensure that they have strong contracts and controls in place.

breakdown.heading: Liability
breakdown.body: Servicers are liable for AI vendor errors

breakdown.heading: Contracts
breakdown.body: Strong vendor contracts are necessary to manage liability

breakdown.heading: Controls
breakdown.body: Servicers need to implement strong AI controls

breakdown.heading: Underwriting
breakdown.body: Here's what this actually changes when a file hits underwriting: increased scrutiny of AI-driven decisions

carousels.my_take: The key to managing AI vendor liability is to have strong contracts and controls in place.

carousels.title: AI-Native Land Acquisition
carousels.caption:
AI-native land acquisition is changing the game for homebuilders. Here's what this means for the industry. With the ability to analyze parcels in minutes, homebuilders can now evaluate thousands of parcels per month. This has significant implications for the homebuilding industry and could lead to increased efficiency and productivity.

Source : https://tinyurl.com/24kpw9mr
#SafetrustMortgage #MortgageIntelligenceDaily #aihomebuilding #landacquisition #homeconstruction
carousels.what_happened: AI-native land acquisition can cut site analysis from hours to minutes. This enables homebuilders to evaluate 1,000-2,000 parcels per user each month. With only 1.5% to 2% of US parcels listed at a time, the approach targets off-market discovery and pipeline management.

carousels.my_take: The key to successful AI-native land acquisition is to leverage the technology to analyze and evaluate parcels quickly and efficiently.
